note: Frozen, hand-verified developer-Python contract; this file is the machine-readable authority tools/setup.mjs reads. Widening supportedVersionRange requires re-verifying mypy/ruff/pytest against the new interpreter with recorded evidence, not editing this file in isolation.
rationale: The verification sandbox is Arch/CachyOS with pacman as the sole package manager; python 3.14.6-2 is the only Python package available (no pyenv/uv, no 3.9-3.13 package). mypy 2.3.0 on Python 3.14.6 analyzes the target-version="py39" Ruff/mypy configuration with no internal error, superseding an earlier mypy-2.1.0-era internal error recorded against this same configuration. The developer interpreter version is pinned narrowly to what was actually verified.
